_about: ACCEPTANCE-TEST ARTIFACT, not yet a live consumer input. The v2 manifest proposed in explorer_manifest_audit_2026-10-04.md section 8, filled for all 24 live surfaces, so that the audit's central claim -- that all six hand-maintained page tables can be GENERATED from one `identity` block -- can be tested by diff instead of asserted. Read scripts/generate_page_tables.py and architecture/manifest_schema_acceptance_test_2026-10-04.md with it. It sits BESIDE manifests.json rather than extending it in place because the test may not modify any of the six live tables, and manifests.json is one of them; at migration time its `pages` block is what merges into manifests.json as `tabs`, under the unified key namespace.
_unknown: The string "unknown" is a POSITIVE assertion: the audit did not establish this value, and nothing here invented one. `null` is different -- it means established-as-absent. Silence (a missing key) is a defect, not a value.
_revisions: Fields marked _rev:Rn in the per-page notes are NOT in section 8. They were forced by trying to generate the six tables and are argued in the acceptance-test document. R1 route.row, R2 identity.v1_key, R3 sections (chapter-level explainers), R4 explain.title, R5 capability.find_expected, R6 capability.find_probe, R7 identity.family as a LIST.
